whatsappMessage:
Hi J.D. Mall team,

I noticed your shopping mall has strong 4.1★ reviews from 770+ visitors on SP Verma Road in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for store directories and ongoing retail offers.

Maine aapke mall ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme floor-wise store directory, daily deals, aur direct WhatsApp leasing/visitor inquiry integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/jdmall

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi J.D. Mall team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business (J.D. Mall) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with a digital floor-wise store directory, festive/daily offer banners, and direct visitor inquiries right here on SP Verma Road in Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact retail stores, brand directory, aur leasing info setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
